name: autovacuum
description: Enables or disables the autovacuum launcher daemon, which automatically runs VACUUM and ANALYZE operations to maintain table health and optimizer statistics.
symptoms: Long-running transaction blocking due to frozen XID wraparound risk

constraints.hard_rule: value == true if track_counts == true, otherwise autovacuum is ineffective

tuning_tips: Keep enabled ('on') in production unless managing vacuum manually; disable only for specific short-term maintenance windows or immutable archival tables.
